OK, 

poster on another thread pointed out my problem. I had included the install_github( 'wc14goals', 'mpodell' ) call in my server.R and ui.R files deployed to ShinyApp.io.

The proper way to do it is to install the github package locally with the latest version of devtools  (v. 1.5 as of this writing) and including only the library (package) and data(package) commands in my server.R and ui.R files. Removing the install_github command fixed the problem.

-Mike
